title: Our Mission
text:
SASA will:

Produce up-to-date publications of high quality, which include the South African Statistical Journal (SASJ) and the Conference Proceedings.
Send members news and information through the SASA Newsletter.
Organise an annual conference.
Give members access to the SASJ, the official journal, and other publications.
Do all other work that helps these goals in a careful and organised way.

title: Apply for SASA Membership
text:
Membership is open to all persons and organisations with an interest in the goals of SASA. The Executive Committee reviews all applications.
Membership runs from 1 April to 31 March each year.

title: Apply for SASA Membership
text:
Membership types

Ordinary membership

For any person with an interest in the mission and goals of SASA. Ordinary members can vote at the Annual General Meeting. They get the Newsletter and the SA Statist J. They pay the member rate at the conference.

Senior membership

For members who are 65 or older and were members for the 10 years before they turned 65. Senior members get the same benefits as ordinary members.

Student membership

For registered students at a South African tertiary institution. Student members get the Newsletter. They do not get the SA Statist J and cannot vote. Student names do not show on the website.

Affiliated membership

For companies, societies and other organisations with an interest in the aims of SASA.
